purpose: Independent estimates of human learning effort; no inherited human estimates were inspected before selecting these budgets.
evidence: All route durations are assumptions informed by inspected task content. Recorded learning studies are plausibility checks, not measured target-endpoint calibration.

assessment.target: one unaided first submitted function per unseen problem; all original tests must pass
assessment.training: instruction, ordinary Python documentation, executing and debugging practice code, and human or deterministic feedback; no generative-AI assistance
assessment.excluded: previous learning, breaks, background elapsed time, and separate endpoint-assessment time

routes.starting_cohort: No prior programming; ordinary English reading, numeracy and computer use.
routes.target_repertoire: Scalar expressions, returns, conditionals, simple list/string operations and single-pass loops.
routes.rationale: A narrow first-function route. Twelve hours of guided instruction and tracing, eighteen hours writing/debugging basic variations, and five hours delayed retrieval and error review. Reaching this low aggregate target does not require solving the hard algorithmic tail.

routes.starting_cohort: No prior programming; ordinary English reading, numeracy and computer use.
routes.target_repertoire: Broader list/string manipulation, conversion, accumulators, filtering, common built-ins and explicit boundary cases.
routes.rationale: Adds collection fluency and more independent function practice to the beginner foundation. The forty-hour practice allowance is near the order of the observed 46.6-hour novice homework sum, but neither the duration nor benchmark endpoint is copied from that course.

routes.starting_cohort: No prior programming; ordinary English reading, numeracy and computer use.
routes.target_repertoire: Combining two or three transformations, nested iteration, simple counting/search, parsing and multi-condition specifications.
routes.rationale: Increases independent implementation and delayed mixed practice. Extra time is for selecting and combining operations without execution feedback at the final assessment, not a complete algorithms or software-engineering course.

routes.starting_cohort: Already writes basic Python functions using scalar operations, branches and simple loops; assumed 12.2% first-submission HumanEval accuracy.
routes.target_repertoire: Broader collection operations, composed functions, simple search/counting and consistent handling of empty inputs, duplicates and boundaries.
routes.rationale: An additional-learning route from existing elementary Python, so it excludes editor setup and initial syntax acquisition. Fifty-six hours of varied implementation plus twenty hours of delayed mixed practice address weak independent transfer, rather than relearning the entire beginner foundation.
routes.starting_repertoire_short: elementary scalar, branch and loop functions

routes.starting_cohort: Already uses Python functions, loops and common list/string operations; assumed 22.6% first-submission HumanEval accuracy, with gaps in composition and unfamiliar specifications.
routes.target_repertoire: Reliable multi-step specification translation, nested data, state tracking, simple algorithmic patterns and mixed first-submission problem solving.
routes.rationale: An additional-learning route from a broader elementary repertoire. The larger practice budget covers multiple solution patterns and alternative formulations; it does not require mastery of every HumanEval task or general professional software development.
routes.starting_repertoire_short: functions, loops and common list/string operations
